name: 33767 · Clearwater, FL
findings: ZIP 33767 (Clearwater) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33767 (Clearwater) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33767 (Clearwater) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
